levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All four required samples carry a described color, an oxidation entry including a stated absence where there is none, and one of the three magnetic settings.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four samples carry all three observations, with one entry giving a bare label rather than a description.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three samples carry all three observations, or all four are present with one observation type missing throughout.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two samples are observed, or magnetism is recorded as a yes or no rather than on the three-setting scale.

criterion: Appearance Testing: Color, oxidation, and magnetic response

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every metal sample carries a spark result with the stream described, and samples that produced no sparks are recorded as such rather than left blank.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every metal sample carries a spark result, with the stream not described on one or more, or a no-spark result left blank.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: One or more metal samples have no spark entry, or a result is recorded for a sample never taken to the grinder.

criterion: Appearance Testing: Spark test record for the metal samples

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All four required samples carry the Checkpoint 1 hypothesis, an agrees or conflicts verdict, and a named deciding observation with a reason tied to that specific test.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four carry the hypothesis and the verdict, with the reason on one or two applying to any test rather than the one named.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three samples are weighed, or all four carry a verdict with no deciding observation named.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than two samples are weighed, or the Checkpoint 1 hypothesis is not carried forward.

criterion: Evidence and Refined ID: Appearance weighed against the density hypothesis

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A refined identification is given for all four required samples, each citing a density result and an appearance result.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: A refined identification is given for all four samples, citing only one evidence type on one or more of them.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than four refined identifications are given, or identifications are restated from Checkpoint 1 with no appearance evidence cited.

criterion: Evidence and Refined ID: Refined hypothesis citing both evidence types
